name: ToolCall
intent: Collapsible display of an agent tool/function call — name, arguments, and result — inside an AI conversation.
when: Show an agent's tool invocation and its output in chat

extracted: cva variants/sizes remain generated by the structural extractor

lineage.confidence: unset — projection round-trip verified; no held-out eval yet

props.name: name
props.description: Function/tool name shown in the header (e.g. "Read", "Bash").

props.name: args
props.description: Compact argument preview shown in the header — truncated to a single line.

props.name: status
props.description: Drives the leading status icon and tone. Defaults to "success".

props.name: summary
props.description: Always-visible result summary line (e.g. "Read 1 line"). Shown in both closed and open states.

props.name: children
props.description: Output rendered inside the ScrollArea when open.

props.name: outputMaxHeight
props.description: Max height of the output ScrollArea. Defaults to 320. Pass a number (px) or any CSS length.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the default status icon (e.g. a function-specific glyph).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.
